classification.difficultyReason: Translate the labelled interior angles into a 360° equation, recognise the marked right angle, and collect repeated pronumerals before solving a routine linear equation.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Unshaded irregular quadrilateral ABCD with the four supplied interior angle labels. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: A=110 degrees, B=60 degrees, C=alpha, D=140 degrees; cyclic order ABCD.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown appear.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
\alpha+110^\circ+60^\circ+140^\circ&=360^\circ\\
\alpha+310^\circ&=360^\circ\\
\alpha&=50^\circ
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral PQRS with PS vertical, SR horizontal and a coordinate-derived right-angle square at S. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: P=110 degrees, Q=beta+20 degrees, R=beta-10 degrees, S=90 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown expressions appear.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
110^\circ+(\beta+20^\circ)+(\beta-10^\circ)+90^\circ&=360^\circ\\
2\beta+210^\circ&=360^\circ\\
2\beta&=150^\circ\\
\beta&=75^\circ
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral EFGH, horizontal base EH, external gamma+10-degree label with a curved pointer into the interior angle at F. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown expressions appear.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}
\gamma+(\gamma+10^\circ)+2\gamma+\gamma&=360^\circ\\
5\gamma+10^\circ&=360^\circ\\
5\gamma&=350^\circ\\
\gamma&=70^\circ
\end{align*}$$
